office_does: The Assessor values all taxable property in Cowlitz County so property taxes can be apportioned among owners.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Emily Wilcox (prefers Independent) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Cowlitz County Assessor (prefers Independent) seeking another term; the only candidate.
highlights: Lists fair and equitable assessments that comply with Washington law as the top priority [S1]
Says the office has modernized operations and technology to raise productivity and cut costs [S1]
Notifies residents in advance when appraisers will be working in their area [S1]
